file_change.purpose: Define the minimum durable semantic-review evidence representation used by Core Planning and Build acceptance.
implementation: Define Draft 2020-12 JSON schema for Assurance report phase, governed subject identity, PASS/FAIL disposition, rationale, evidence references, and case-specific findings.
Each finding records stable case identity, PASS/FAIL disposition, rationale, and optional evidence references.
Keep findings non-normative; the schema SHALL NOT provide fields that create, amend, supersede, or withdraw normative authority.
Do not require deferred mature review-criteria registries, reviewer-profile metadata, or independent exact-revision fields when the governed subject/evidence references already establish identity.
